description: Filter UOM dropdown options by item's DefaultUom and UomConversion table instead of showing all UOMs

newEndpoints.description: Returns UOM options available for a given item based on DefaultUom + UomConversion rules

requiredSamples.featureSchema: // No new schema needed - uses existing LookupDto
requiredSamples.entity: // No new entity - uses existing Item, Uom, UomConversion
requiredSamples.selectFieldUsage:
<SelectField
    name={`lineItems.${index}.uom`}
    label={t('fields.uomId')}
    placeholder={t('placeholders.uomId')}
    dataSource='uoms-by-item'
    watchField={`lineItems.${index}.itemId`}
    watchParamKey='itemId'
    clearOnWatchChange
    searchable
    className='col-span-1'
/>
